lanKey.title: LAN key
lanKey.description: Cloud-issued LAN key for this machine. Required for local Wi-Fi mode; never share it.

advertisedIp.title: Homebridge LAN IP
advertisedIp.description: IP address the coffee machine can call back to.

commandPayloads.title: Verified local command payloads
commandPayloads.description: Optional model-verified ECAM payload map. Example: {"start": {...}, "stop": {...}}.

cloudBridgeUrl.title: Coffee Link/Ayla bridge URL (fallback)
cloudBridgeUrl.description: Optional HTTPS fallback endpoint. It must expose GET /status and POST /command.

cloudEmail.title: Coffee Link email
cloudEmail.description: Used only by Homebridge to obtain this machine's LAN configuration.

cloudPassword.title: Coffee Link password
cloudPassword.description: Used only for the Coffee Link sign-in; never send this in chat.

cloudDeviceDsn.title: Coffee Link device DSN
cloudDeviceDsn.description: Optional when your Coffee Link account contains more than one machine.

lanIp.title: Known machine IP
lanIp.description: Optional; discovery will use this first.

discoveryUrl.title: Discovery endpoint
discoveryUrl.description: Optional authenticated endpoint returning { ip }. The plugin does not guess or control a LAN protocol.

allowUnverifiedLanControl.title: Allow unverified LAN control
allowUnverifiedLanControl.description: Deprecated. V3 only sends payloads explicitly supplied in commandPayloads.
